content: For the example ( "Implicit Discourse Relation Recognition" ), the baseline neural tensor model predicted both implicit relations wrongly (“Implicit-Contingency” between DU2 and DU3; “Implicit-Expansion” between DU3 and DU4), while our paragraph-level model predicted all the four discourse relations correctly, which indicates that paragraph-wide contexts play a key role in implicit discourse relation prediction.
